basic_details.job_title: RGNAU Professional Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 10 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU), Fursatganj, Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, is engaging 10 Professional Trainees: 8 in Management, 1 in Electrical Engineering / Civil Engineering and 1 in Pharmacy. RGNAU is a Central University under the Ministry of Civil Aviation, Govt. of India. The engagement is for one year at first and may be extended by a maximum of one more year. The monthly stipend is Rs. 20,000/- in the first year and Rs. 22,000/- in the second year if the engagement is extended. Indian Nationals not older than 30 years must apply online at rgnaunt.samarth.edu.in by 6 Decemb

content_sections.heading: About RGNAU
content_sections.text: Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU) is a Central University under the Ministry of Civil Aviation, Govt. of India. It was established by the Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU) Act, 2013 (No. 26 of 2013), and its headquarters are at Fursatganj, Dist. Amethi, Uttar Pradesh. The University describes itself as an institution of higher learning in the aviation field that aims to provide research for the aviation industry in India.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The University is engaging 10 Professional Trainees in three fields. * The number of Electrical Engineering / Civil Engineering positions may increase or decrease at the time of selection. The notice also says that the number of positions advertised may be treated as tentative, and that the University has the right to increase or decrease the number of positions at the time of selection. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals may apply. The age limit is the same for every post: candidates should not exceed 30 years as on the last date of submission of the online application (6 December 2026). Age and qualifications are counted as on the closing date for submitting the online application form. The notice does not mention any experience requirement for these posts. The desirable qualifications for each post are listed below. Certifications in Public Policy, Governance, Project Management, or Strategic Management. Academic exposure to policy analysis, organizational management. Proficiency in research methodology, report writing, and policy drafting. Ability to prepare policy notes, briefing papers, presentations, and analytical reports for senior Government officials. Electrical Estimation and Costing: preparation of detailed estimates, BOQ, rate analysis, quantity take-off, material costing, cable sizing, and estimation based on CPWD/DSR rates. Training in estimation, costing and tender documentation. Postgraduate Diploma/Certificate course in Construction Management, Project Management or Quality Control. Certification in AutoCAD, STAAD, Primavera, MS Project or other relevant civil engineering software. Training in estimation, costing and tender documentation. Working knowledge of MS Office and digital inventory logging and fundamental emergency first-aid awareness. A person who has been convicted by any Court of Law, or against whom criminal proceedings are pending. A person who is not a citizen of India. Any other category of person disqualified for appointment by the Govt. of India/UGC. Candidates whose degrees, diplomas or certificates come from an institution that the University Grants Commission, New Delhi, has declared fake or derecognised. Degrees must have been awarded by a recognized University / Institute. Applicants are responsible for checking their own eligibility for the training field. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's Degree in Business Management or Administration or in a relevant Management related disciplines from a recognized University or Institution, and strong knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and presentation tools.
Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering from a recognised Polytechnic/Institute/University approved by the State Board of Technical Education or AICTE or UGC.
Degree/Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognised Polytechnic/Institute/University approved by the State Board of Technical Education or AICTE or UGC.

Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) or Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) from an institute recognized by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), with valid registration as a Pharmacist with the Central or State Pharmacy Council (mandatory).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Duration: one year at first, which may be extended by a maximum of one more year. The longest possible engagement is 2 years. Working days: selected trainees must work 6 days a week, in their own field (Management, Electrical Engineering / Civil Engineering or Pharmacy). Leave: 01 day of leave for each completed month of training. Location: Fursatganj, Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, or any other location as the University requires. Termination: any indiscipline or irregularity will lead to the training being cut short without any reason being given and without prior notice. No regular post: a Professional Trainee has no right to claim any benefit, compensation, absorption or regularisation of service with the University, and will not be given seniority in any grade of the University. Offer of appointment: the terms and conditions are sent to selected candidates in an offer of appointment. If a candidate does not accept them within the stipulated time, the offer is treated as withdrawn.

rows.period_of_engagement: Second / final year of engagement, if extended

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGNAU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply only online, through the University's online application link: https://rgnaunt.samarth.edu.in/. Follow the instructions given on the portal and submit the application before 6 December 2026 . Incomplete applications will be rejected outright. Keep a hard copy of the submitted application form. Keep copies of all certificates, educational qualification and experience documents, testimonials and other documents that support your eligibility. Shortlisted candidates must submit these at the interview. For queries, write to [email protected] and mention the name of the position. Hard copy of the application form Copies of certificates, educational qualification and experience documents, and testimonials (to be submitted at the interview, if shortlisted) Other documents supporting eligibility Original certificates of age, qualifications, experience and so on (to be shown at the test/interview) Valid registration as a Pharmacist with the Central or State Pharmacy Council (Pharmacy post)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: if a large number of applications is received, the Screening Committee may use additional screening criteria to shortlist candidates before the interview. Method: the University may decide its own method of shortlisting and of evaluating candidates' performance in the interview. Call letters: call letters and other messages about the test/interview will be sent to eligible candidates by email only. A notice will also be posted on the University website. Interview attendance: candidates must be present physically or online for the interview on the date, time and venue given. Requests to change the schedule will not be accepted. Interview date: not announced yet. The notice asks applicants to check www.rgnau.ac.in regularly for updates, corrigenda and interview dates, and to check their email. Meeting the qualification and experience requirements does not by itself entitle a candidate to be engaged.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RGNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 Professional Trainee positions: 8 in Management, 1 in Electrical Engineering / Civil Engineering and 1 in Pharmacy. The University may increase or decrease the number of positions at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the RGNAU Professional Trainee posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application is 6 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the RGNAU Management Trainee post?
faq.answer: The requirement is a Master's Degree in Business Management or Administration or in a relevant Management related disciplines from a recognized University or Institution, plus strong knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and presentation tools.

faq.question: Q4. Can diploma holders apply for the Engineering and Pharmacy trainee posts?
faq.answer: Yes. The Electrical and Civil Engineering posts accept a Degree/Diploma in that branch from a recognised Polytechnic/Institute/University approved by the State Board of Technical Education or AICTE or UGC. The Pharmacy post accepts D.Pharm or B.Pharm from a PCI-recognised institute, together with valid Pharmacist registration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for RGNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should not exceed 30 years as on the last date of submission of the online application, which is 6 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for RGNAU Professional Trainees?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is Rs. 20,000/- in the first year of engagement and Rs. 22,000/- in the second (final) year, if the engagement is extended.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for RGNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://rgnaunt.samarth.edu.in/ by following the instructions given there, before 6 December 2026. Keep a hard copy of the form and copies of your certificates for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for RGNAU Professional Trainees?
faq.answer: Selection is by interview, which candidates attend physically or online. If many applications are received, the Screening Committee may use additional screening criteria to shortlist candidates. Call letters will be sent by email only.

faq.question: Q9. Is the RGNAU Professional Trainee engagement a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is for one year and may be extended by a maximum of one more year. Trainees have no right to claim absorption or regularisation of service with the University.

faq.question: Q10. Will RGNAU pay travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the test/interview.
